## About
Auto Motion Sales and Repair is a pre-owned car dealer and repair shop on Excelsior Blvd in St Louis Park. Our passion is European cars, and our service department handles everything from regular maintenance to complicated diagnostics and repairs.
We work on Mercedes-Benz, Audi, BMW, Volkswagen, Porsche, Aston Martin, Land Rover, Volvo and more, using parts from local European parts suppliers. Before you head to the dealership, bring your car to us.

## Services
- Auto sales: Cars for sale in St Louis Park, with a focus on European makes.
- Financing: Financing options when you buy a car from us.
- Maintenance, diagnostics and repair: From routine maintenance to complicated diagnostics and repairs on European vehicles.
- Full synthetic oil change: Keep your car running well with a full synthetic oil change.
- Collision center: Collision work for your car.
- Full service car wash: A full service car wash, plus fuel and convenience services.

## FAQ
Q: Which makes do you work on?
A: We specialize in Mercedes-Benz, Audi, BMW, Volkswagen, Porsche, Aston Martin, Land Rover, Volvo and more.

Q: Can I see my car's service history?
A: Yes. Our software lets customers see their service history and maintenance requirements so they can plan appointments.

Q: Where are you located?
A: Our service department is at 4419 Excelsior Blvd in St Louis Park.
